title: AC 04.1 – Location Filter – Included in collapsible filter accordion
description: AC 04 — CRUD — Location filter control is present and functional within the collapsible filter accordion.
preconditions:
User role: HQ/CM Staff
Location: Riso TAC (Teacher Availability Calendar)
Filter accordion visible on page
Location list exists: ["Room A", "Room B", "Room C"]
steps_actions:
1. "Navigate to Riso TAC"
2. "Expand filter accordion (if collapsed)"
3. "Verify Location filter control is present"
4. "Click on Location filter dropdown"
5. "Select "Room A""
6. "Observe calendar"
steps_result:
1. "TAC page loads with filter accordion visible"
2. "Accordion expands showing filter controls"
3. "Location filter input or dropdown visible in accordion"
4. "Dropdown opens showing available locations"
5. "Location filter applied to calendar"
6. "Calendar now shows only lessons in Room A"

1. "page = Riso TAC"
2. "accordion_state = expanded"
3. "filter_type = location"
4. "locations = [Room A, Room B, Room C]"
5. "selected_location = Room A"
6. "expected_display = filtered_by_room_a"

title: AC 04.2 – Location Filter – Selection persists after accordion collapse and expand
description: AC 04 — Regression + State Transition — Location filter selection retains its value when filter accordion is collapsed and re-expanded.
preconditions:
User role: HQ/CM Staff
Location: Riso TAC
Location list exists: ["Room A", "Room B", "Room C"]
Filter accordion expanded; Location filter available
steps_actions:
1. "Select Location filter to "Room B""
2. "Verify calendar displays only Room B lessons"
3. "Collapse filter accordion (click collapse button/icon)"
4. "Expand filter accordion again (click expand button/icon)"
5. "Verify calendar display unchanged"
steps_result:
1. "Location filter applied; Room B shown as active"
2. "Calendar filtered correctly"
3. "Accordion collapses; Location filter remains applied to calendar"
4. "Accordion expands; Location filter shows Room B still selected"
5. "Calendar still shows only Room B lessons; no filter reset"
steps_data:
1. "selected_location = Room B"
2. "display_state = filtered_by_room_b"
3. "accordion_state = collapsed"
4. "accordion_state = expanded"
5. "expected_display = still_filtered_by_room_b"
